subject: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Cole <aaron@edgescale.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in

Hi Aaron — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we pull together the executive panel: 

1) Stakeholders you identified: Sarah (CEO), Mark (CIO), Dana (Procurement), Rahul (Security) — please confirm full names/titles above.
2) Economic buyer appears to be Sarah Lin; procurement timeline you mentioned is ~6–8 weeks post-technical sign-off.
3) Security questionnaire: you said EdgeScale would share the completed vendor questionnaire and a SOC 2 snapshot. Please attach those when you can.
4) Next steps I propose:
   - Confirm steering panel attendees and a 60-minute exec readout + decision slot; we’ll bring a short 10–12 minute business case + demo and leave time for Q&A.
   - Aditya will handle the security deep-dive and coordinate the questionnaire.
   - Marissa will prepare a short procurement checklist and draft SOW for legal review.

Proposed timing: Week of Apr 12 or Apr 19 for the executive panel. If you can share 2–3 60-minute windows that work for Sarah/Mark/Dana/Rahul, we’ll coordinate calendar invites and a short prep call with your core team.

Attachments: placeholder SOW template (we'll tailor once requirements confirmed).

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Aaron Cole <aaron@edgescale.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@edgescale.com>, Mark Ritter <m.ritter@edgescale.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@edgescale.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in

Evelyn — thanks for the succinct recap. Confirming the roster and small clarifications below: 

- Full names/titles: Sarah Lin (CEO), Mark Ritter (CIO), Dana Ortiz (Head of Procurement), Rahul Singh (Head of InfoSec).
- Economic buyer is Sarah; procurement org will own contract negotiation and timing.
- We will attach the completed vendor questionnaire and a redacted SOC 2 summary by end of day Mon, Apr 5.
- Timing: Sarah is traveling Apr 12–14. Best windows would be Apr 19 (all day) or Apr 21 (AM). 

We prefer a 60-minute slot on Apr 19, ideally 10:00–11:00 PT. Can you hold that while we confirm internally?

Thanks — Aaron
Aaron Cole
VP, Strategic Accounts, EdgeScale
aaron@edgescale.com
+1 415 555 2219

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Cole <aaron@edgescale.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in

Thanks Aaron — holding Apr 19 10:00–11:00 PT tentatively. Appreciate the SOC 2 and questionnaire. A couple of small asks from our side so we can tailor the prep materials: 

- Decision criteria: can Sarah/Mark share the top 3 decision criteria (e.g., latency SLAs, data residency, integration timeline)? This helps us keep the business case tight.
- Procurement gates: does EdgeScale require an initial PO or will legal need a signed SOW + purchase order? That changes the order of operations on our side.
- Security deep-dive: Aditya (cc'd) will send a short list of follow-up questions after we review your questionnaire. If Rahul prefers, we can set a 30-minute security sync before the exec panel.

We’ve attached a draft SOW (EdgeScale_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and a short procurement checklist for you and Dana to scan. Let us know who on procurement should be looped in for legal redlines.

Best — Evelyn

From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@edgescale.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aaron Cole <aaron@edgescale.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@edgescale.com>, Mark Ritter <m.ritter@edgescale.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@edgescale.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in

Evelyn/Team — quick answers from procurement side: 

- Decision criteria (top priorities from our execs):
  1) Predictable cost per inference and transparent unit economics.
  2) Data handling / residency controls and audit logs.
  3) Integration risk and time-to-production (60–90 days target).

- Procurement process: Legal will need a negotiated SOW and signed contract. We typically issue a PO only after contract countersigned and budget sign-off from finance.

- For legal redlines, please route the draft SOW to procurement@edgescale.com and cc me. I will assign a contracting partner who will own the doc review.

- Security: Rahul is happy to do a 30-minute sync. Suggested times: Apr 8 9:00–9:30 PT or Apr 9 11:00–11:30 PT.

I attached our standard procurement checklist and a timeline snapshot. We will also upload the vendor questionnaire to your Drive folder once completed.

Thanks — Dana
Head of Procurement, EdgeScale

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@edgescale.com>, Aaron Cole <aaron@edgescale.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@edgescale.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roster, logistics and buying-path check-in

Rahul/Aaron — thanks for offering the security sync. I’ll take the prep on the questionnaire and will send a short list of follow-ups by EOD Apr 6 after we ingest your answers.

Confirming Rahul's window: Apr 9 11:00–11:30 PT works on our side — I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (SOC 2 scope, data at rest/in transit, logging/audit access).

Evelyn/Marissa — I’ve attached the redlined questionnaire stub (edgescale_security_questionnaire.xlsx) with initial flags where we typically request clarifications. Marissa, I’ll need that SOW to include a 90-day integration milestone and an option for dedicated capacity in case they need lower latency SLA.

Linking hubspot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8342
DocuSign: Aaron, if you can share DocuSign contact for signatory, we’ll populate the SOW and routing.

Regards — Aditya
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
